records.name: Tele-MANAS (14416)
records.what: The Government of India's free national mental health helpline, open 24 hours, for counselling, emotional support and referrals, in about 20 languages.
records.start: Call 14416 or 1-800-891-4416 and choose your language.

records.name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
records.what: The national ministry for the development and well-being of Scheduled Tribes, including scholarships, hostels, coaching and forest rights. Most of its schemes are carried out by state governments.
records.who: Members of Scheduled Tribes and their organizations.
records.start: Find the scheme you need on the ministry's website, or ask your state tribal welfare department.
